- @azure Rule - Use Azure Best Practices: When generating code for Azure, running terminal commands for Azure, or performing operations related to Azure, invoke your `azure_development-get_best_practices` tool if available.

## 📋 Documentation Standards

All markdown documents created or modified in this project MUST follow these conventions:

### 🎭 Emojis
- Use relevant emojis in section headers: 🎯 Goals, 🏗️ Architecture, ✅ Done, ⚠️ Warnings, 🧪 Testing, 🚀 Deployment, 📋 Tasks, 🔧 Configuration, 🛡️ Security, 📊 Status
- Use ✅ ❌ ⏳ 🔄 for task/checklist status indicators

### 📊 Status Bar
Every doc must include a status bar after the title:
```
| Status | Owner | Phase | Last Updated |
|--------|-------|-------|--------------|
| ⏳ In Progress | Author | Phase N | YYYY-MM-DD |
```

### 📋 Version Control Matrix
Every doc must end with a version control matrix:
```
## 📋 Version Control
| Version | Date | Author | Changes |
|---------|------|--------|---------|
| 1.0.0 | YYYY-MM-DD | Author | Initial creation |
```
Use semver: MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH. Update on every meaningful edit.
